name: @pipeworx/mcp-eu-energy-imports

tools.name: import_origins
tools.description: Which countries a country imports natural gas, crude oil or coal FROM, ranked, with each supplier's share of the total and Russia's share called out. Works for Germany, any EU member, or the EU as a whole ("EU"). Annual by default (latest published year); gas and oil also accept a month. Answers "where does Germany get its gas", "how much gas does the EU still import from Russia", "who supplies Italy's oil". Source: Eurostat energy statistics.

fuel.description: Fuel: gas, oil (crude) or coal (solid fossil fuels)

geo.description: Importing country as a 2-letter code ("DE", "FR", "IT", "EL" for Greece) or "EU" for the EU-27 total. Default "DE".

period.description: Year "2024" or, for gas and oil only, month "2025-06". Default: latest published year.

top_n.description: How many suppliers to list (1-30, default 10)

product.description: Optional Eurostat energy-product code to narrow within the fuel (e.g. "G3200" for LNG only, "O4600" for oil products).

tools.name: russia_import_trend
tools.description: Year-by-year Russian share of a country's (or the EU's) imports of natural gas, crude oil or coal: Russian volume, total imports and the percentage, for each year. Shows the collapse after 2022 -- e.g. Germany's Russian gas share by year. Source: Eurostat energy statistics.

tools.name: import_dependency_rate
tools.description: Energy import dependency: the percentage of a country's energy needs met by net imports, for all energy or for gas, oil or coal, by year. Above 100% means stocks were built up. Source: Eurostat energy statistics.

tools.name: energy_mix
tools.description: A country's (or the EU's) energy mix: gross available energy split into natural gas, oil, solid fossil fuels, renewables, nuclear, waste, and net electricity and heat, in terajoules and as a percentage share, for one year. Source: Eurostat energy balances.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-eu-energy-imports forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the eu-energy-imports pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
